使用安装器创建的唯一明确链接 `$SHARED_INSTALL/omp/skills/competitive-intelligence-workflow`。三者必须解析到同一个内容地址版本。若宿主安装目录不同，只替换 `SHARED_INSTALL`，不要复制第二份或把源码 checkout 当成安装包。\\n43:\\n44:\\n45:## 3. \\\\\\n56:  --receipt \\\"$PWD/docs/acceptance/host-smoke/codex.json\\\"\\n57:uv run python tools/run_host_smoke.py --allow-real-host \\\\\\n58:  --install-root \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL\\\" --host hermes --case host-smoke-v1 \\\\\\n59:  --require-external-host-process --project-root \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL/projects/hermes\\\" \\\\\\n60:  --receipt \\\\\\n63:  --require-external-host-process --project-root \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL/projects/omp\\\" \\\\\\n64:  --receipt \\\"$PWD/docs/acceptance/host-smoke/omp.json\\\"\\n65:```\\n66:\\n67:完成后运行：\\n68:\\n69:```bash\\n70:uv run pytest tests/hosts/test_fresh_install.py \\\\\\n71:  tests/hosts/test_conformance.py \\\\\\n72:  tests/hosts/test_real_host_smoke.py -q\\n73:```\\n74:\\n75:三份回执必须符合 `schemas/host-receipt.schema.json`，绑定当前候选包、`host-smoke-v1` case digest、真实宿主版本、安装入口、初始 no-draft 阻断、补件重开事件、恢复后 HTML、事件链、最终清单和真实退出码。`process/session/run` 必须互不相同；包摘要、案例摘要和最终语义状态必须一致。回执归档规则见 [`docs/acceptance/host-smoke/README.md`](../acceptance/host-smoke/README.md)。\\n76:\\n77:## 4. \\\"$FRESH_ROOT/shared\\\"\\n```\\n\\n确认 `package-manifest.json`、`fixtures/catalog.yaml`、`fixtures/synthetic/host-smoke-v1/` 和包内 `schemas/host-receipt.schema.json` 均在 `$FRESH_ROOT/shared` 后，使用同一份 bundle 安装到规范候选根。安装器只新建内容寻址版本，不删除旧版本；如果目标根已有其他版本，命令会失败关闭。\\n\\n```bash\\nSHARED_INSTALL=\\\"$HOME/.cc-switch/skills/clinical-research/competitive-intelligence-workflow\\\"\\nuv run python \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL/shared\\\"\\ntest -L \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL/omp/skills/competitive-intelligence-workflow\\\"\\n```\\n\\nCodex 和 Hermes 使用 `$SHARED_INSTALL/shared`；OMP 使用安装器创建的唯一明确链接 `$SHARED_INSTALL/omp/skills/competitive-intelligence-workflow`。三者必须解析到同一个内容地址版本。若宿主安装目录不同，只替换 `SHARED_INSTALL`，不要复制第二份或把源码 checkout 当成安装包。\\n\\n\\n## 3. 运行三宿主真实冒烟\\n\\n每个宿主都必须从自己的真实安装入口启动独立外部进程，会话和项目目录也必须独立：\\n\\n命令必须显式携带 `--allow-real-host`；缺少该开关只会返回环境阻断，不会启动宿主。\\n\\n\\n```bash\\nuv run python tools/run_host_smoke.py --allow-real-host \\\\\\n \\\"$PWD/docs/acceptance/host-smoke/codex.json\\\"\\nuv run python tools/run_host_smoke.py --allow-real-host \\\\\\n  --install-root \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL\\\" --host hermes --case host-smoke-v1 \\\\\\n  --require-external-host-process --project-root \\\"$SHARED_INSTALL/projects/hermes\\\" \\\\\\n  --receipt \\\"$PWD/docs/acceptance/host-smoke/hermes.json\\\"\\nuv run python tools/run_host_smoke.py --receipt \\\"$PWD/docs/acceptance/host-smoke/omp.json\\\"\\n```\\n\\n完成后运行：\\n\\n```bash\\nuv run pytest tests/hosts/test_fresh_install.py \\\\\\n  tests/hosts/test_conformance.py \\\\\\n HTML、事件链、最终清单和真实退出码。`process/session/run` 必须互不相同；包摘要、案例摘要和最终语义状态必须一致。回执归档规则见 [`docs/acceptance/host-smoke/README.md`](../acceptance/host-smoke/README.md)。\\n\\n## 4.
